verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no feature for exporting all of a user's LiteLLM data (keys, teams, spend records, configuration, logs) in open formats to support leaving the product. Logging request input and output to S3, GCS or OpenTelemetry is observability streaming, an adjacent feature rather than a data-export or exit capability. OpenAI-format compatibility eases switching LLM providers, not leaving LiteLLM itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
